newsitem.title: USA: SECURITY CAPITAL'S TRUSTS LAUNCH RIGHTS OFFERINGS.
newsitem.headline: SECURITY CAPITAL'S TRUSTS LAUNCH RIGHTS OFFERINGS.

text.p: Three trusts whose majority shareholder is Security Capital Group Inc have begun separate shareholder rights offerings in order to raise money to pay off borrowings under their lines of credit, according to statements released by the trusts on Thursday.
Security Capital Pacific Trust said it had begun a rights offering of 7.4 million shares at $21.8 each.
The trust said the offering, which expires on September 9, will generate money to repay borrowings under certain credit facilities, including its $350 million unsecured revolving line of credit.
Security Capital Pacific is a real estate operating company focusing on the development, acquisition, operation and long-term ownership of multi-family communities.
Its stock was 9/16 lower at 22-7/8 in early afternoon trading on Thursday.
Security Capital Industrial Trust said it had begun a rights offering of 4.9 million shares at $21 each.
The trust said the offering, which expires on September 9, will provide it with money to pay off borrowings under its $350 million unsecured revolving line of credit.
It will also invest in additional distribution properties in its target markets, it said.
Security Capital Industrial owns and operates distribution properties.
Meanwhile, Security Capital Atlantic Inc said its rights offering comprised of 2.6 million shares at $22.4 each.
It said the offering, also to expire on September 9, will generate funds to pay back loans under its $350 million unsecured revolving line of credit.
The trust, which operates much like the Pacific one, had its stock 8/16 higher at 23-15/16.
